name: Moto Guzzi V11 Sport / V11 Le Mans
engine: 1064 cc air-cooled 90-degree V-twin, fuel injected, six-speed, shaft drive
intro: Guzzi's sporty V11 range. Fuel injection, a six-speed box and a shaft that needs regular oil changes.

K: Guzzi big twins use a car-type dry clutch and a separate gearbox and final drive. Change all three oils, not just the engine oil.

recallNote: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start. Recalls on these models change over time.
